proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Let Z be the irreducible component of R through e, which is unique by the geometrically-irreducible lemma, thought of as an integral closed subscheme. The integral closures k'_s of s(k) and k'_t of t(k) in Gamma(Z, O_Z) are fields (varieties integral-closure-ground-field lemma) and equal as subrings by the unique base field proposition. Since e factors through Z, the displayed commutative diagram shows k'_s = s(k) and k'_t = t(k), whence s(k) = t(k) and then s = t; in other words Z is a closed subscheme of the stabilizer G = R times over (t, s) and the diagonal of U over U. The lemma follows as both G and R are equidimensional, by the locally-finite-type-dimension lemma and the groupoids group-scheme-over-field lemma: the component Z of R lies inside G, so dim(G) is squeezed between dim(Z) and dim(R) = dim(Z). (source lines 1561-1587)

core_obligations: Set up Z: the irreducible component of R through e is unique and geometrically irreducible by lemma-groupoid-on-field-geometrically-irreducible; consider it as an integral closed subscheme of R (proof lines 1562-1564). Identify the base fields: the integral closures k'_s of s(k) and k'_t of t(k) in Gamma(Z, O_Z) are fields by varieties-lemma-integral-closure-ground-field, and varieties-proposition-unique-base-field gives k'_s = k'_t as subrings of Gamma(Z, O_Z) (proof lines 1565-1571). Conclude s = t: since e factors through Z, the displayed commutative diagram shows k'_s = s(k) and k'_t = t(k); hence s(k) = t(k), which with the diagram implies s = t, and therefore Z is a closed subscheme of G = R times_{(t, s), U times_S U, Delta} U (proof lines 1572-1583). Dimension squeeze: Z is an irreducible component of R and a closed subscheme of G; both G and R are equidimensional (lemma-groupoid-on-field-locally-finite-type-dimension and groupoids-lemma-group-scheme-finite-type-field), so dim(G) lies between dim(Z) and dim(R) = dim(Z), whence dim(R) = dim(G) (proof lines 1584-1586).
proof_roadmap: Pick the unique component Z through e via the geometrically-irreducible lemma (proof lines 1562-1564).
Identify the two integral closures as fields and force them equal by the unique base field proposition (proof lines 1565-1571).
Use the factoring of e through Z to conclude s = t and Z inside the stabilizer G (proof lines 1572-1583).
Squeeze the dimension of G between Z and the equidimensional R (proof lines 1584-1586).
